messages:
Maria: FYI nightly billing: 28 card declines. Gateway returns: 6 do_not_retry, 15 insufficient_funds, 7 issuer_decline. Need a plan for retries + customer comms.

billing-bot: Auto-report: invoices affected: [INV-8910, INV-8912, INV-8919, INV-8927, ...]. MRR at risk: $42,300. Error breakdown included.

Alex: For soft declines (insufficient_funds/issuer_decline) propose automated retry sweep: attempts at 0h, +6h, +24h (3 attempts). For do_not_retry, no auto-retry 																							 send card-update flow and flag for manual collect.

Raj: Agree. For invoices > $5k (4 customers) let's pause auto-retries and surface wire option in the email. PeakHealth has pending wire instructions but finance hasn't verified bank details yet.

Jamie: I can draft the email template. Draft text: "Hi <Customer>, we attempted to charge invoice <INV-XXXX> and it was declined. We'll retry automatically once. To update your card now: <payment-portal>. To pay by wire reply 'WIRE' and we'll share instructions." Will add a short subject line.

Maria: Ops asks: (1) approve retry sweep for soft declines, (2) mark do_not_retry accounts manual-collect and send card-update email, (3) hold auto-retries for the 4 high-value invoices until wire options are confirmed. Need audit logs for retries.

Nora: Approve with conditions: (A) retries must be logged to invoice history (who/when/response), (B) any customer > $25k ARR notify assigned AE in Slack before retry.

Alex: I'll add logging and AE ping. Dry-run CLI to validate list:
./billing retry --filter "status:declined AND method:card AND code:soft" --schedule "0h,6h,24h" --notify true --dry-run
Run without --dry-run to execute.

Maria: I'll hold the 4 invoices and mark PeakHealth pending-wire-review. Jamie, include wire option and the "Reply WIRE" instruction in the email so CS/AEs can pick up.

Jamie: Will post template in #customer-ops for AE sign-off before sending.

Raj: Note: 2 ACH setups failed. Switch those to micro-deposit flow and pause recurring debits until verification completes. Save the attempted setup metadata in the payment method notes.

billing-bot: Actions recorded: retry_sweep(dry-run), manual_collect_flag(6), hold_for_wire(4), ach_microdeposit(2). Ticket FIN-4537 created.

Maria: Dry-run results: 22 soft declines selected, expected ~45% success on second attempt based on history. No gateway rate-limit warnings. Proceeding to execute live sweep now.

Nora: Proceed as long as logging and AE pings are in place. Escalate to payments infra if >10% gateway bounces.

Alex: Standing by for any gateway oddities.

Jamie: Email template posted to #customer-ops. Short subject: "Action needed: payment failed for your Redwood invoice"

Maria: Live sweep started at 1832010118. Audit export uploaded: FIN/collections/sweeps/1832010001.csv. Closing here, tracking in FIN-4537.
